info.name: backend
info.description:
Rust/Axum API backend for jana2u-pos, a point-of-sale system for a repair/retail shop.

All requests inherit the collection-level Bearer auth (`{{accessToken}}`) — set it once per environment (Developement/Production) after obtaining a JWT via Auth > Login (its Tests script auto-populates `{{accessToken}}`/`{{userId}}` for you on success, so nothing to copy/paste). Admin-gated endpoints (inventory category/subcategory writes, Billing > Cancel Invoice, and every Suppliers/Supplier Products/Purchases request — reads included) require the token's `role` claim to be `admin`. Permission-gated endpoints (all of Inventory except the module-status stub, Customers writes, Billing > Complete Sale/Record Payment, Repairs writes, Print Jobs writes, Reports reads (`reports:view`), Users CRUD, Auth > List Login Sessions) require the token's `permissions` claim to include a specific permission (e.g. `inventory:read`, `inventory:write`, `billing:write`, `repairs:write`, `print_jobs:write`, `reports:view`, `users:manage`, `sessions:view`) — see CLAUDE.md's "Auth, users & permissions" section for the full role→permission table; the seeded Admin (`cargo run --bin seed_admin`) has every permission. Users CRUD is additionally scoped by an Admin/Manager hierarchy on top of that permission gate — see the Users folder's description.

Only these endpoints work without a token at all: Health, Auth > Login, Swagger, and the `GET /` module-status stubs still remaining on Inventory/Billing/Customers/Reports (Repairs and Print Jobs lost theirs once they gained real `GET /` list endpoints — those now require a token like every other read). Everything else returns 401 `UNAUTHORIZED` without a valid Bearer token, and 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`/`ADMIN_REQUIRED` if the token lacks the required permission or role.

Base URL (`{{backendBaseUrl}}`), and the access token, are environment variables — switch the active Postman environment to point requests at dev vs prod.

request.description: Liveness check — always returns 200 if the process is up. Doesn't touch MongoDB.

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Exchanges email/password for a JWT carrying the account's role and its role's default permission set. No auth required. On success, this request's Tests script auto-populates the `{{accessToken}}`/`{{userId}}` environment variables, so every other request's inherited Bearer auth picks it up immediately.

Use `cargo run --bin seed_admin` to bootstrap the very first Admin account (registration is admin-provisioned only — there is no public register endpoint).

Returns the account the inherited Bearer token belongs to. Re-reads from MongoDB on every call (rather than only decoding the token), so a deactivated account is caught immediately even with a still-valid token.

**Requires a valid JWT** or the API returns 401.

query.description: Restrict to one account's login history

request.description:
Login history audit log — newest first. Each entry snapshots the account's name/email/role at the moment of that login, so it keeps reading the same way even if the account is later renamed. Not paginated the way Suppliers/Products are — this is an append-only log that grows without bound.

**Requires the token's `permissions` claim to include `sessions:view`** (granted to Admin/Manager by default) or the API returns 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

item.description: Login, "who am I", and login-session (audit) history. `users` (below) owns account CRUD/role management — see CLAUDE.md's "Auth, users & permissions" section.

item.name: Billing

request.description: Placeholder status route for the billing module. Real endpoints are not implemented yet.

Completes a sale: creates the invoice (and, unless `payment.isCredit`, its payment record(s)), decrements stock for any `productKey` line items, and marks any linked repair/print-job ticket (`sourceTicketKey`) delivered. `cashierId` is never sent — the completing cashier is always the bearer token's user. There is no tax in this system. The request is grouped into sub-objects: `staff{cashierName}`, `customer{}` (optional — omit for a walk-in with no linked account; only used as typed when `customerKey` is absent, otherwise resolved from the linked `Customer` record), `items[]`, `pricingAdjustments{}` (optional — omit for no discount; `discountType` is `"percentage"` [0-100, e.g. 7.5] or `"fixed"` [a cents amount]; the server computes the actual `discountCents` from this against the resolved subtotal), and `payment{paymentMethod, isCredit, amountReceivedCents, splitPayments, cardLast4, cardRef, onlineRef, onlineNote, dueDate}`. `shopProfileSnapshot`/`notes`/`warrantyTermsSnapshot`/`documentSelection` stay top-level. Line items are resolved server-side, never trusted from the payload: a retail item's `name`/`sku`/`unitPriceCents` come from the product record via `productKey`, a repair/print item's `unitPriceCents`/`assignedEmployeeName`/`sourceTicketNumber` come from the ticket via `sourceTicketKey`, and an item's `totalCents` is always computed as `unitPriceCents * quantity - discountCents`. `name`/`unitPriceCents` are only required on an item when it has no `productKey`/`sourceTicketKey` to resolve from (an ad-hoc line). `subtotalCents`/`totalCents`/`changeDueCents` are likewise never sent — `subtotalCents` is the sum of the resolved items' `totalCents`, `totalCents` is `subtotalCents - discountCents`, and `changeDueCents` (when `payment.amountReceivedCents` is given) is `amountReceivedCents - totalCents`. An unresolvable `productKey`/`sourceTicketKey`/`customerKey` rejects the whole request before any write. `warnings` in the response surfaces any post-write side effect (stock decrement, ticket status, customer balance) that failed without rolling back the already-durable invoice/payment — see CLAUDE.md's billing module notes.

**Requires the `billing:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim — granted to every role by default (see `core::constants::roles::default_permissions`), so in practice any logged-in user may call it; the check exists for future role tuning. Returns 401 without a token, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the permission is ever revoked from a role, 400 for an invalid `pricingAdjustments`/split-leg total, 404 if a `productKey`/`sourceTicketKey`/`customerKey` doesn't resolve.

query.description: paid | credit — paid means status==paid AND not on credit; credit means isCredit OR status==pending
Exact match: cash | card | online | split
Only "today" is meaningful — scopes to invoices created today

request.description:
List invoices with free-text search, status/customer filtering, and pagination.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Sales & Invoices History KPI cards: today's sales, today's invoice count, outstanding credit, and average basket value.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Fetch a single invoice by its Mongo ObjectId or prefixed `key`.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Voids an invoice — reverses stock and customer balance where applicable, with a mandatory `reason` for the audit trail. Blocked with 409 `INVOICE_ALREADY_VOIDED` if already voided, or `INVOICE_HAS_PAYMENTS_CANNOT_VOID` if any payment beyond the original sale-time one has been recorded.

**Requires Admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`. Requires a non-empty `reason` or 400.

Manually marks a fully paid invoice as `closed` — done, nothing more expected to happen to it. Blocked with 409 `INVOICE_NOT_CLOSABLE` unless the invoice is `paid` and has no open (non-voided) credit note against it.

**Requires Admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

Renders (or returns the cached) PDF for an invoice. `documentType` in the path is either `a4-invoice` or `thermal-receipt` — this request is the A4 variant; duplicate it and change the last path segment to `thermal-receipt` for the receipt variant, which also accepts the `paperWidthMm` query param (58 or 80, default 80). Response is `application/pdf` bytes, not the usual JSON envelope.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Thermal-receipt variant of Get Invoice Document — see that request's description for the shared behavior. Response is `application/pdf` bytes, not the usual JSON envelope.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Records a payment against an invoice (e.g. partial credit repayment). Blocked with 409 if the invoice is already cancelled or the amount exceeds the outstanding balance.

**Requires the `billing:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim — granted to every role by default (see `core::constants::roles::default_permissions`), so in practice any logged-in user may call it; the check exists for future role tuning. Returns 401 without a token, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the permission is ever revoked from a role.

List every payment recorded against an invoice.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Creates a credit note against an existing invoice (or, with `noReceipt: true` + `overrideReason` + an Admin token, without one): adjusts stock per returned line's `condition`/`disposition`, calculates net cashback or extra amount due (capped at what was actually paid, allocated across payment methods via `refundBreakdown` for a split-paid invoice), updates customer financials, and updates the invoice's returned quantity / `refundedCents` / `creditNoteCount`.

**Requires the `billing:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim. No-receipt and past-return-window requests additionally require the caller to hold `Role::Admin`, with a non-empty `overrideReason`. Returns 401 without token, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`/`MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED`, 400 if return quantity exceeds purchased quantity or a `damaged` line has no `disposition`, 404 if invoice/product not found, 409 `INVOICE_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_CREDIT_NOTE` if the invoice is voided, `RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED` if past the window without override.

query.description: Search credit note number, invoice number, or customer name

request.description:
List credit note records with search, date/invoice/customer filtering, and pagination.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Fetch a single credit note record by its Mongo ObjectId or prefixed `key` (`cn_...`).

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Reverses a credit note's stock/payment/customer-balance effects and marks it `voided`, with a mandatory `reason` for the audit trail. Reverses `return_restock` movements (deducts the quantity back out); does not attempt to reverse `return_write_off`/`return_supplier_rma` (audit-only) or re-credit exchange stock.

**Requires Admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`. Requires a non-empty `reason` or 400.

Renders (or returns the cached copy of) the credit note's printable PDF via the external document-server. The only supported documentType is `credit-note`; anything else returns 400. Responds with `application/pdf` bytes.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role).

request.description:
Create a customer profile. Only `name` and `primaryPhone` are required; omitted optional fields stay empty. The server mints `id`/`key` — the test script copies both into collection variables.

**Requires `customers:write` permission** (Admin and Manager roles): staff tokens get 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, no token gets 401.

request.description:
Full replace — any optional field omitted from the body is cleared, unlike Update Customer (PATCH) which leaves omitted fields untouched. Send the row's current `version` in `If-Match`; a stale value returns 409 `VERSION_CONFLICT`.

**Requires `customers:write` permission** (Admin and Manager roles).

Partial update — send only what changed; omitted fields keep their current values (an explicit `null` clears a field).

**Requires `customers:write` permission** (Admin and Manager roles).

Soft-delete one customer. Blocked with 409 while the customer still has an outstanding credit balance — settle those first.

**Requires `customers:write` permission** (Admin and Manager roles).

Delete several customers in one call; each id may be a Mongo ID or prefixed key.

**Requires `customers:write` permission** (Admin and Manager roles).
List all employees (not paginated). Requires `employees:read` — held by every role (Admin/Manager/Staff), since Staff needs to browse employees when assigning a repair/print job.

Create a new employee HR/commission profile. `key` is server-generated, never client-supplied. Requires `employees:write` (Admin/Manager only). This is a profile only — no login is created; use Users > Create User with `employeeKey` set to give this employee a login.
Get a single employee by its Mongo id. The response's `login` field is `null` unless a user account has been linked via `employeeKey`.

Partially update an employee. Omitted fields are left untouched. Requires `employees:write`. Optionally send an `If-Match` header with the current `version` for optimistic-locking conflict detection (409 `VERSION_CONFLICT`).
Soft-deletes an employee. Requires `employees:write`. Blocked with 409 `EMPLOYEE_HAS_LOGIN` while the employee still has a linked login account — remove the login first (Users > Delete User).
Delete multiple employees at once. Ids that fail (invalid, not found, or blocked by EMPLOYEE_HAS_LOGIN) are silently skipped. Requires `employees:write`.

item.name: Inventory

request.description: Inventory module status/health check.

query.description: Free-text search across product name/sku/barcode and category/subcategory names
Only products at/below their min stock threshold
1-based page number applied to every subcategory's product table
Page size per subcategory table (frontend default/max is 10)

request.description:
Hierarchical Inventory & Stock overview for the frontend accordion page: dashboard metrics (total items, category/subcategory counts, low-stock alerts), every category paired with its subcategories, and — per subcategory — a paginated (max 10/page) product data table. Backed by a single MongoDB `$facet` aggregation pipeline over `products` (see CLAUDE.md's "MongoDB Aggregation Pipelines" section) rather than one query per subcategory, so `page`/`limit` here apply uniformly to every subcategory table in the response.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

query.description: Only products at/below their min stock threshold

request.description:
List products with search, filters, pagination and sorting.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

Fetch a single product by its Mongo ObjectId.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

body.raw:
{
  "autoGenerateBarcode": true,
  "name": "iPhone 15 Pro Max Tempered Glass",
  "categoryKey": "{{categoryKey}}",
  "subcategoryKey": "{{subcategoryKey}}",
  "costPriceCents": 450,
  "sellingPriceCents": 1500,
  "minStockThreshold": 10,
  "suppliers": [
    {
      "supplierKey": "{{supplierKey}}",
      "quantity": 30,
      "costPriceCents": 450,
      "referenceNo": "INV-2026-001",
      "notes": "Initial stock batch"
    }
  ]
}

request.description:
Create a new physical product. `categoryKey`/`subcategoryKey` must be a valid pair — the system-generated keys of an existing category/subcategory (see GET /categories/valid), never their display names. Prices are integer cents. `sku` is NOT sent — it's auto-generated server-side from the resolved category/subcategory names (e.g. "PHO-SCR-0001"); the request body has no field for it. For barcode generation, either set `autoGenerateBarcode: true` to have the server mint an EAN-13 barcode, or supply a manual `barcode` (8-14 numeric digits) — the two are mutually exclusive, and both may be omitted if the product doesn't need one yet. `suppliers`, if provided as a list of intakes with `supplierKey`, `quantity`, `costPriceCents`, `referenceNo`, and `notes`, will atomically link each supplier, record purchase history receipts, and compute the starting `stockQuantity` as the sum of all intake quantities. Like `sku`, `barcode` is immutable after creation.

**Requires the `inventory:write` permission** — held by Admin and Manager only, so a Staff token gets 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Returns 401 without a token.

Partially update a product — omit any field to leave it unchanged. `barcode` is not editable via this endpoint (immutable after creation, same as `sku`).

**Requires the `inventory:write` permission** — held by Admin and Manager only, so a Staff token gets 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Returns 401 without a token.

Delete a single product by id.

**Requires the `inventory:write` permission** — held by Admin and Manager only, so a Staff token gets 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Returns 401 without a token.

Delete multiple products at once. Ids that fail to parse as ObjectId are silently skipped.

**Requires the `inventory:write` permission** — held by Admin and Manager only, so a Staff token gets 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Returns 401 without a token.

Adjust a product's stock by a signed delta (positive = receipt, negative = consumption/sale).

**Requires the `inventory:write` permission** — held by Admin and Manager only, so a Staff token gets 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Returns 401 without a token.

List products at or below their minimum stock threshold.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

Stock movement (audit trail) history for a single product.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

query.description: Filter by lifecycle status (in_stock, sold, returned_resalable, returned_faulty, under_warranty_claim, written_off). Omit to list every serial for the product.

request.description:
Lists the individually-tracked serial units for a serialized product, optionally filtered by lifecycle status — powers a sale-time "pick a unit to sell" picker (`status=in_stock`) and a return-time serial lookup.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

query.description: Filter to a single product's movements. Omit for the whole shop's audit trail.
Filter by movement type (e.g. manual_adjustment, purchase_receipt).

request.description:
Paginated stock movement (audit trail) history across every product, optionally filtered by product and movement type. Use Product Stock Movements instead for a single product's unpaginated history.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

List all categories with their subcategories.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

Create a new top-level category with its starter subcategories (by name — each becomes its own subcategory document with a generated key). The response's `key`/`subcategories[].key` are what other requests (Create Product, Update/Delete Category, Add/Remove Subcategory) must use — copy them into the `categoryKey`/`subcategoryKey` collection variables.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

Partially update a category, looked up by its key. Renaming `name` is a pure display-label change — products reference this category by its immutable key, so nothing else needs to change.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

Delete a category, looked up by its key. Blocked with 409 while any product still references it; on success also deletes every subcategory under it.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

Category/subcategory key+name pairs (nested), for a client-side form that needs to display names while submitting `categoryKey`/`subcategoryKey` on product create/update.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

List the subcategories of a single category, looked up by its key.

**Requires the `inventory:read` permission** — held by all three roles, so any logged-in user may call it. Returns 401 without a token.

Add a new subcategory to a category (looked up by its key). The response includes the new subcategory's generated `key`.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

Remove a subcategory (looked up by its key). Blocked with 409 while any product still references it.

**Requires admin JWT** (`role: admin` claim) — inherited Bearer token must be an admin token or the API returns 403 `ADMIN_REQUIRED`.

Inventory & Stock KPI cards: total items, category/subcategory counts, and low-stock alert count.

**Requires a valid Bearer token with `inventory:read`** or the API returns 401/403.

item.name: Print Jobs

query.description: One exact status: received | diagnosing | in_repair | ready | delivered | cancelled
Only "today" is meaningful — scopes to jobs created today

request.description:
List print jobs with search, status filtering, and pagination. `GET /` used to be a static module-status placeholder — it is now this real, authenticated list endpoint (see CLAUDE.md's `app::build_router` public-routes note).

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Print Jobs screen KPI cards: today's job count, today's revenue, open job count, and average job value.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Create a print job ticket. `ticketNumber` is never client-supplied — reserved server-side on create. `jobType` must be one of `mug | t-shirt | handbill | banner | custom`; `status` defaults to `received` if omitted. The request nests customer identity into `customer{customerKey, customerName, customerPhone}` and technician assignment into `assignment{assignedEmployeeId, assignedEmployeeName, splitType, splitValue}` (both optional groups). If `customer.customerKey` is set, `customer.customerName`/`customerPhone` in this request are ignored and resolved server-side from the linked `Customer` record instead — only used as typed when there's no `customerKey` (a walk-in with no linked account).

**Requires the `print_jobs:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim — granted to every role by default (see `core::constants::roles::default_permissions`), so in practice any logged-in user may call it; the check exists for future role tuning. Returns 401 without a token, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the permission is ever revoked from a role.

Fetch a single print job by its Mongo ObjectId or prefixed `key`.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Partially update a print job — omit any field to leave it unchanged. The request nests customer identity into `customer{customerKey, customerName, customerPhone}` and technician assignment into `assignment{assignedEmployeeId, assignedEmployeeName, splitType, splitValue}` (both optional groups). If `customer.customerKey` is set, `customer.customerName`/`customerPhone` in this request are ignored and resolved server-side from the linked `Customer` record instead — only used as typed when there's no `customerKey` (a walk-in with no linked account).

**Requires the `print_jobs:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim — granted to every role by default (see `core::constants::roles::default_permissions`), so in practice any logged-in user may call it; the check exists for future role tuning. Returns 401 without a token, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the permission is ever revoked from a role.

Soft-deletes a print job (sets `deletedAt` so it can still appear as a sync tombstone).

**Requires the `print_jobs:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim — granted to every role by default (see `core::constants::roles::default_permissions`), so in practice any logged-in user may call it; the check exists for future role tuning. Returns 401 without a token, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the permission is ever revoked from a role.

item.name: Repairs

query.description: One exact status: received | diagnosing | in_repair | ready | delivered | cancelled
Only "today" is meaningful — scopes to tickets created today

request.description:
List repair tickets with search, status filtering, and pagination. `GET /` used to be a static module-status placeholder — it is now this real, authenticated list endpoint (see CLAUDE.md's `app::build_router` public-routes note).

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Repair Jobs screen KPI cards: today's job count, today's revenue, open ticket count, and average job value.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Create a repair ticket. `ticketNumber` is never client-supplied — reserved server-side on create. `status` defaults to `received` if omitted. The request nests customer identity into `customer{customerKey, customerName, customerPhone}` and technician assignment into `assignment{assignedEmployeeId, assignedEmployeeName, splitType, splitValue}` (both optional groups). If `customer.customerKey` is set, `customer.customerName`/`customerPhone` in this request are ignored and resolved server-side from the linked `Customer` record instead — only used as typed when there's no `customerKey` (a walk-in with no linked account).

`estimatedCostCents` is **optional** — diagnosis-first repairs often can't be priced at intake, so it may be omitted while `status` is `received`, `diagnosing`, or `cancelled`. Moving a ticket to `ready` or `delivered` (on create or via `PATCH`) requires a price to already be set or included in the same request, otherwise the request is rejected with `400 REPAIR_PRICE_REQUIRED`.

**Requires the `repairs:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim — granted to every role by default (see `core::constants::roles::default_permissions`), so in practice any logged-in user may call it; the check exists for future role tuning. Returns 401 without a token, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the permission is ever revoked from a role.

Fetch a single repair ticket by its Mongo ObjectId or prefixed `key`.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

The request nests customer identity into `customer{customerKey, customerName, customerPhone}` and technician assignment into `assignment{assignedEmployeeId, assignedEmployeeName, splitType, splitValue}` (both optional groups). If `customer.customerKey` is set, `customer.customerName`/`customerPhone` in this request are ignored and resolved server-side from the linked `Customer` record instead — only used as typed when there's no `customerKey` (a walk-in with no linked account).

**Requires the `repairs:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim — granted to every role by default (see `core::constants::roles::default_permissions`), so in practice any logged-in user may call it; the check exists for future role tuning. request.description:
Delta sync feed for offline-first clients. Pass `cursors` (JSON map or comma-delimited `resource=cursor,...`) to resume per-resource, or `since` as a shorthand single cursor when syncing one resource. `limit=0` returns no items but still reports `nextCursor` pointing at the newest row — use this after taking a snapshot via the plain REST list endpoints to start incremental syncing without replaying the whole collection. Paging is oldest-first by `(updatedAt, key)`, and deleted rows are returned as tombstone keys under each resource's `deleted` list — see CLAUDE.md's "Offline sync" section.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Per-resource watermark: the newest `updatedAt` and its cursor for every syncable resource. A client adopts these cursors directly right after taking a full snapshot via the plain REST list endpoints, so its first `GET /sync/changes` call is a true delta — deriving a starting cursor from `/sync/changes` itself isn't possible, since that endpoint pages oldest-first and would hand back the *first* row's cursor instead.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

item.description: Delta sync for the offline-first frontend (`../frontend` mirrors every syncable collection into IndexedDB). See CLAUDE.md's "Offline sync" section for cursor format, soft-delete semantics, and the `Idempotency-Key`/`If-Match`/`X-Device-Id` headers other write endpoints use alongside this feed.

request.description:
List user accounts (not paginated — a shop's staff roster is small). An Admin's list never includes the Admin account; a Manager's list is filtered to Staff accounts only (any `role` query param a Manager sends is ignored in favor of that).

**Requires `users:manage` (Admin) or `users:manage:staff` (Manager)** in the token's `permissions` claim, or the API returns 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Scope beyond that gate is role-based: an Admin may create/view/edit/delete Manager and Staff accounts; a Manager may do the same to Staff accounts only. An Admin account is never reachable through this endpoint by anyone — not even by another Admin, and not even by itself — this is a single-shop deployment with exactly one Admin, bootstrapped via `cargo run --bin seed_admin` and otherwise untouchable via the API.

Its default permission set is computed fresh at that user's next login, never stored on the account.
